{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D intensity volatility", "construction": "standard deviation of R&D expenses divided by sales over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with volatile R&D expenses may be more likely to experience breakthroughs or failures, leading to greater uncertainty and potentially higher returns. This measure captures the variability of innovative efforts.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Foreign sales growth acceleration", "construction": "difference between the 3-year and 1-year growth rates of foreign sales", "rationale": "Firms with accelerating foreign sales growth may be benefiting from emerging market trends or successful international expansion, leading to higher expected returns. This measure identifies firms with improving global prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee growth rate", "construction": "1-year growth rate of total employees", "rationale": "Firms with high employee growth rates may be experiencing rapid expansion, leading to increased productivity and potentially higher returns. This measure captures the pace of firm-level growth.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply chain efficiency", "construction": "accounts payable divided by cost of goods sold, averaged over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with efficient supply chains may be better positioned to manage costs and respond to changes in market conditions, leading to higher expected returns. This measure evaluates the effectiveness of working capital management.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Board independence ratio", "construction": "number of independent board members divided by total board members", "rationale": "Firms with more independent board members may be less subject to managerial entrenchment and more likely to make decisions that benefit shareholders, leading to higher expected returns. This measure assesses the level of board oversight.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Average employee tenure", "construction": "total employees divided by the number of employees hired in the past year", "rationale": "Firms with high average employee tenure may have more experienced and productive workforces, leading to increased efficiency and potentially higher returns. This measure evaluates the stability of the workforce.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Inventory turnover volatility", "construction": "standard deviation of inventory turnover over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with volatile inventory turnover may be more exposed to changes in demand or supply chain disruptions, leading to greater uncertainty and potentially higher returns. This measure captures the variability of inventory management.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental liability", "construction": "estimated environmental liability divided by total assets", "rationale": "Firms with high environmental liabilities may face significant future costs or reputational damage, leading to lower expected returns. This measure assesses the potential risks associated with environmental concerns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Product diversification", "construction": "Herfindahl index of revenue across different product segments", "rationale": "Firms with diversified product offerings may be less exposed to industry-specific risks and more likely to benefit from emerging trends, leading to higher expected returns. This measure evaluates the level of product concentration.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Corporate giving intensity", "construction": "charitable donations divided by net income, averaged over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with high corporate giving intensity may be building strong relationships with stakeholders and enhancing their reputation, leading to increased brand value and potentially higher returns. This measure captures the level of philanthropic efforts.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
